Мы не собираем команду заново под каждый: We do not assemble a new team for every project. We have our own plant, our own formwork, our own crews and an in-house technical department. We know our output to the day and our costs to the lari. We buy materials directly and lock in prices with suppliers for the full volume of the project.
Краны, опалубка, бетононасосы — не завис: Cranes, formwork, concrete pumps — no dependence on rentals.
Постоянный штат монолитчиков и инженеров: A permanent staff of concrete crews and engineers.
Договоры с заводами на весь объём объект: Contracts with manufacturers for the full volume of the project.
Считаем всё до старта, а не по ходу стро: We cost everything before we start, not as we go.
Единственная причина изменить цену — изм: The only reason for the price to change is a change in the brief initiated by the client: a different layout, more floor area, other materials. In that case we cost only the difference, formalise it in a supplementary agreement and start the work only once it is signed. No "it turned out along the way".
Цена в договоре 2022 года. За 16 месяцев: The price was set in a 2022 contract. Over 16 months of construction, rebar went up 30%. The client paid exactly the contract sum.
Заказчик добавил бассейн на этапе строит: The client added a swimming pool during construction. We costed the difference, signed a supplementary agreement and moved the deadline by 3 weeks. The rest of the estimate stayed unchanged.
